sections.heading: C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Turning, intersections and roundabouts
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Turning, intersections and roundabouts

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A40
Approach a roundabout slowly, obey its signs and yield to pedestrians and bicyclists. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A40
Yield to traffic already circulating on the left and enter a roundabout only through a safe gap. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A40
Keep speed low inside a roundabout. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A40
Signal right as the roundabout exit approaches and yield to pedestrians and bicyclists while leaving. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A40
Always yield to emergency vehicles at a roundabout. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A40
If an emergency vehicle approaches before you enter the roundabout, pull over and let it pass. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A40
If already inside the roundabout, continue to the exit before pulling over for an emergency vehicle and avoid stopping within the circle. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A40
Before entering a multilane roundabout, follow the roadside signs and pavement arrows to select the correct lane. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A40
For a left turn at a multilane roundabout, generally use the left lane or another lane specifically signed and marked for left turns. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A40
For a right turn at a multilane roundabout, generally use the right lane or another lane specifically signed and marked for right turns. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A40
For straight travel through a multilane roundabout, use the lane indicated by the signs and arrows. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A41
At a cloverleaf interchange, watch for vehicles entering or leaving the highway. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A41
Cloverleaf weaving areas can put entering and exiting traffic together in the short freeway sections between loop ramps. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A41
Cloverleaf ramp loops often require a much lower speed for their curves. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec11-R15 | anchor: A41
The handbook contrasts cloverleaf weaving issues with diamond, diverging-diamond and single-point urban interchange alternatives. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec11-R16 | anchor: A42
General intersection rules still apply when driving a diverging-diamond interchange. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R17 | anchor: A42
At the first DDI signal set, follow the signs, signals and road markings through the crossing, where traffic appears to move like a one-way street. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R18 | anchor: A42
The handbook’s DDI description calls left turns onto the freeway free-flow movements without a stop to enter the ramp. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R19 | anchor: A42
A driver going straight through the described DDI passes a second set of traffic signals. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R20 | anchor: A42
Pedestrians in a DDI use designated walkways and cross only at crosswalks. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R21 | anchor: A42
A bicyclist in the described DDI may use a bike lane or the pedestrian walkways and crosswalks. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R22 | anchor: A42
Do not cross an interstate highway’s median. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R23 | anchor: A42
If an interstate exit is missed, continue to the next exit and never back up on the interstate. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R24 | anchor: A42
Avoid unnecessary interstate lane changes and stay right unless overtaking and passing another vehicle. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec11-R25 | anchor: A42
On an interstate, maintain a steady pace with traffic while obeying posted speed limits. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0042]
